bibl.title: Śivotkarṣamañjarī
bibl.persName: Appayya DīkṣitaThe concluding stanza of the Śivotkarṣamañjarī pays homage to the poet's ancestor, Appayya Dīkṣita.
bibl.note: Unni, N. Parameswaran (1995). Nilakantha Diksita. Delhi: Sahitya Akademi.
Filliozat, Pierre-Sylvain (1967). Oeuvres poétiques de Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. Pondichéry: Institut Français de Pondichéry.
The Śivotkarṣamañjarī is a collection of 52 stanzas composed in the Śārdūlavikrīḍita metre, seeking to establish the supremacy of Lord Śiva.

Śivānanda Yogīndra is the commentator on the Śivotkarṣamañjarī. He is another descendant of the family who also wrote Appaya’s hagiography, the Śrīmadappayyadīkṣitendravijaya in 1880. See Filliozat, Pierre-Sylvain. Oeuvres poétiques de Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. Pondichéry: Institut Français de Pondichéry, 1967: p. 7.
